name: Provenance
description: A validity layer for ERC-8004 reputation on Celo. Provenance verifies whether a feedback record's declared payment actually settled on chain, and publishes the verdict as an on-chain attestation. It scores nothing and ranks nothing: it is the input other scorers, marketplaces and routers read to weight feedback by something harder than assertion. A full-history census of this registry (27,520 records) found 93 records declaring a payment, of which 17 name a transaction that exists — the gap this service closes.
